description: Download a PNG, JPEG, or WebP image (up to 512 KB, no SVG) from a public https URL into the workspace, for a form's logo on its hosted page. Returns an image id: set it as theme.logo (the light or only palette) or theme.dark.logo, then save the theme with fillo_push_form. Importing the same image again returns the same id. Needs forms:write.

url.description: Public https URL of the image.

name: fillo_import_logo
title: Import a logo image
